tools.name: list-available-docs
tools.description: Lists all available library documentation from Context7. The library names can be used with 'get-library-documentation' to retrieve documentation.

libraryName.description: Optional library name to search for and rerank results based on

tools.name: get-library-documentation
tools.description: Retrieves documentation for a specific library from Context7. Use 'list-available-docs' first to see what's available.

libraryName.description: Name of the library to retrieve documentation for (e.g., 'upstash-redis', 'nextjs'). Must match exactly a library name from 'list-available-docs'.

topic.description: Specific topic within the library to focus the documentation on (e.g., 'hooks', 'routing').

tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens of documentation to retrieve (default: 5000).Higher values provide more comprehensive documentation but use more context window.
